title: Handle LINE group join/leave events and per-group response policies cleanly
context_summary: Customers invite the LINE Official Account into multi-person work groups to test agents.
observation: Dropping events without source.userId silently broke group join welcomes and bind flows.
verified_action: Process join/leave events, bind NH-CODE atomically, enforce off|mention_only|keyword|always modes, and support report read/create/dispatch across channels.
